[[Speak with Headmaster Greico (Ranger)]] | followed by = [[Free the Fur]] | profession = Ranger | primary = y | secondary = n }} Sends new Canthan Rangers to their first trainer. ==Quest information== === Requirements === {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Ranger | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search Sunqua Vale for [[Sujun]]. ===Early benefits=== *{{skill icon|Charm Animal}} *{{skill icon|Power Shot}} *{{skill icon|Troll Unguent}} ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Sujun can be found near the middle of Sunqua Vale. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Greico ''Rangers must hone primal survival instincts that have lain dormant for generations. This means living in perfect harmony with nature. [[Sujun]], my assistant, will provide the initial training to help you achieve this. Look for him in [[Sunqua Vale]].'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will look for Sujun."'' | decline = I'm not ready for lessons yet."'' | ask = If you wish to become a Ranger, you must learn to survive in the wild. Find [[Sujun]] in [[Sunqua Vale]], and begin your studies. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Sujun ''Headmaster Greico sent you to me? Well, I was just about to go out collecting gold to save the endangered blue skale, but I suppose a new student takes precedence. We had better get started on your training, then, so I can get back to it. Those blue skale will not save themselves!''
